title: Align ConfigPanel UI with spec: strict field ordering, spec annotations, comprehensive coverage
body:
Comprehensive spec alignment of the ConfigPanel (ViewConfigPanel) UI against the NamedListView/ListViewSchema spec protocol — covering type alignment, strict field ordering, spec source annotations, and full field coverage validation.

### Type alignment
- `NamedListView.rowHeight` and `ObjectGridSchema.rowHeight` extended from `'compact' | 'medium' | 'tall'` → `'compact' | 'short' | 'medium' | 'tall' | 'extra_tall'` to match `ListViewSchema`
- Zod schema `rowHeight` enum updated to match
- `ROW_HEIGHT_OPTIONS` gains `short` (`gap-px`) and `extra_tall` (`gap-1.5`)
- `clickIntoRecordDetails` switch added to userActions section

```ts
// Before: 3 values
rowHeight?: 'compact' | 'medium' | 'tall';

// After: aligned with ListViewSchema spec RowHeight enum
rowHeight?: 'compact' | 'short' | 'medium' | 'tall' | 'extra_tall';
```

### Strict spec-order alignment
All fields within each section reordered to match NamedListView property declaration order:
- **PageConfig**: `showSort` moved before `showFilters`; `_export` moved before `navigation`
- **Data**: `columns → filter → sort` (was `sort → groupBy → prefix → columns → filter`)
- **Appearance**: `striped/bordered` first, then `color`, `wrapHeaders`, etc.
- **UserActions**: `inlineEdit` before `clickIntoRecordDetails`

### Spec source annotations
Every field (56 total) annotated with `// spec: NamedListView.*` or `// UI extension` comment, documenting the exact spec source for each control.

### Protocol suggestions
4 UI-extended fields identified and documented as pending spec addition: `description`, `_source`, `_groupBy`, `_typeOptions`.

### Tests
- ViewConfigPanel test updated to assert all 5 row-height buttons
- Section field-key tests upgraded from presence-only to **exact ordering validation** per spec
- Comprehensive spec coverage test validates all 44 NamedListView properties are mapped to UI fields
- All 544 console tests pass, 138 types tests pass

### ROADMAP
- P1.8 updated with detailed spec alignment completion notes

> ## 任务内容
> 
> - 全面梳理当前设置面板各 Section（如 PageConfig、Data、Appearance、UserActions、Sharing、Accessibility 等）涉及的 UI 字段、控件、分组、布局细节，与 spec 协议（如 objectViewSchema/listViewSchema/DashboardViewSchema/Field options/控件类型等）进行一一对照

> - 严格以协议（spec）为唯一"蓝本"调整 UI，并补充/修正 panel schema，优先采用声明式映射而不是特殊逻辑/兼容 hack
> - 明确记录每一处改动的 spec 来源，如字段描述/属性、枚举、校验、分组规则、可选/必选项等
> - 用 issues/pr checklist 跟踪全部修正点，确保 UI 能一键映射 spec
> - 若 spec 未覆盖的实际需求，应输出"协议建议"并补充到产品/规范升级流程
> - 要求所有控件命名、顺序、分组、交互、校验、提示信息与协议完全一致，UI 不得自行"优化"字段或布局
> 
> ## 验收标准
> 
> - 设置面板 UI 与 spec 协议字段/层级/校验/分组完全一致
> - 所有 UI 显示字段都有明确 spec 对应/注释
> - 不再存在"协议外"自定义控件或字段，所有特殊兼容、历史遗留 hack 已清理
> - UI 设计遇到协议缺口需同步补齐协议或提交升级建议
